sv.title: Nvidia-besked får Wall Street att rusa
sv.summary: Nasdaqs tekniktunga index rusar 6,7 procent på börsen i New York efter beskedet om att Jensen Huang återinsätts som halvledarbjässen Nvidias vd. Nvidia stiger hela 29 procent.

en.title: Nvidia news sends Wall Street soaring
en.summary: The tech-heavy Nasdaq index surges 6.7 percent on the New York Stock Exchange after the news that Jensen Huang is reinstated as CEO of semiconductor giant Nvidia. Nvidia rises as much as 29 percent.
